verdict.rationale: Missive documents a built-in AI assistant (also called AI Copilot) that runs long sessions with a session tab showing its progress, creates drafts, composes, replies and translates, answers product questions from the docs, and can use tools through built-in and custom MCP integrations. It runs on the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the assistant's task scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution, and native AI that works without the user supplying a key.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting. The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server
Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.
With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI assistant and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
The assistant runs on your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google Gemini.
